options.text: The blue-black colour shows starch is stored as food in the leaf.
Decolourising the leaf makes the iodine colour change easier to observe.
The blue-black colour shows glucose is stored in this leaf.
The blue-black colour shows all nutrients are present in this leaf.

stem:
Kiara softens a leaf in boiling water, removes the green colour with alcohol, then adds iodine. The decolourised leaf turns blue-black. Her worksheet also names glucose and other nutrients.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Iodine turning blue-black on a decolourised leaf detects starch stored as food; removing green colour makes that change easier to see. It does not identify glucose or prove every nutrient is present.
